subject: Notes, highlights, selection toolbar, notebooks (paper templates + Excalidraw), PDF export with ink, ink_ocr handwriting search
body: Brief: docs/segments/13-notes-notebooks.md. Own cloud session. Builds on S12b's ink API (approval pending; coordinate with seg12b-ink on the ledger), S07's embeddings API for note/ink ref types, S06's ContentRenderer selection toolbar slot. Follow docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md and the integration gate (--test-cmd). Use the shared e2e helpers settle()/quiet()/trackApi() from apps/web/e2e/fixtures.ts.
